suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require coronary artery disease/IHD before incident colorectal cancer; explicitly preserve shared lifestyle/metabolic risk factors and surveillance bias. Cohort meta-analysis shows a modest temporal association, not causation. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Coronary Artery Disease / Ischemic Heart Disease and Colon / Rectal Cancer
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus

suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Apply to incident lung/respiratory cancer after CAD/IHD; account especially for smoking and occupational/environmental exposures. Cohort meta-analysis supports association only; shared risk factors are major competing explanations. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
